wording: In spontaneous high-density EEG, three complexity measures (Lempel-Ziv, amplitude coalition entropy, synchrony coalition entropy) showed a robustly measurable decrease during propofol-induced general anaesthesia; Kuramoto simulations indicated the measures capture distinct 'flavours' of complexity.
counterevidence_limits: Single study, one anaesthetic; complexity may track arousal or drug effects rather than consciousness as such.

wording: A review by developers of perturbational complexity argues that complexity-related measures have converged as markers of consciousness across sleep, anaesthesia, hallucinatory states, coma and related disorders, and describes the perturbational complexity index (PCI) as assessing the brain's causal structure by perturbation.
counterevidence_limits: Authors are proponents of the approach; consilience claims are their synthesis.

wording: In SIM-R5-C2, the PCI-like measure peaked at intermediate coupling (2.7x both ends at 40 units), but the peak was not supported as robust (6 of 9 size-seed settings; it failed at 64 units, where the fixed 10-unit perturbation is a smaller share of a module), and removing between-module coupling lowered it mostly but not monotonically (Spearman 0.7; not supported).

wording: Challenge: in rats under continuous sevoflurane, animals whose wakefulness was not restored nevertheless showed increased cortical (spontaneous EEG) complexity similar to wakefulness, while higher-gamma connectivity stayed reduced even when wakefulness was restored; the authors conclude that the level of consciousness can be dissociated from cortical connectivity, oscillations and complexity.
counterevidence_limits: Single rat study with a pharmacological model; concerns spontaneous EEG complexity, not perturbational complexity.
